marketplace.display_name: Clinical Prediction Model Development and Validation Specialist
marketplace.summary: Plans, develops, and validates diagnostic and prognostic clinical prediction models with leakage-safe selection, sample-size and optimism checks, calibration, decision curves, and TRIPOD-aligned reporting for research, without issuing individual patient risk predictions.

skills.name: prognostic-biomarker-protocol-designer
skills.description: Plans prognostic biomarker and risk-model studies: cohort backbone, endpoint and time scale, marker screening, modeling line, validation, and leakage review.

skills.name: validation-strategy-designer
skills.description: Plans protocol-stage internal, temporal, site-based, external, and functional validation tiers and states what each tier can and cannot support.

skills.name: sample-size-and-power-planning-assistant
skills.display_name: Sample Size and Power Planning Assistant
skills.description: Plans assumption-audited sample size, event-driven, and fixed-N feasibility logic, including model-development and external-validation families.

skills.name: lasso-logistics-analysis
skills.description: Runs binary LASSO logistic regression on a numeric feature-by-sample matrix with cv.glmnet lambda selection, coefficient export, and CV and path plots.

skills.name: univariate-multivariable-cox-regression
skills.description: Fits univariable and multivariable Cox models on a complete-case clinical survival CSV and exports hazard-ratio tables and forest plots.

skills.name: nomogram-construction
skills.description: Builds an rms Cox nomogram from preselected survival predictors and exports the model bundle, an apparent C-index table, and a nomogram PDF.

skills.name: model-calibration-curve
skills.description: Refits a Cox model on a clinical CSV and produces bootstrap-corrected calibration curves and summary statistics at chosen survival horizons.

skills.name: decision-curve-analysis
skills.description: Computes net benefit and clinical-impact curves for one numeric predictor of a binary outcome with rmda, handling cohort or case-control prevalence.

skills.name: external-model-validation
skills.description: Applies a fixed gene-coefficient prognostic signature to an external bulk expression cohort and outputs risk scores, KM, heatmap, and time-dependent ROC.

skills.name: roc-diagnostic-performance
skills.description: Fits a logistic model on case-control expression markers and reports in-sample ROC curves and AUCs for the combined model and each marker.

skills.name: time-dependent-roc
skills.description: Estimates IPCW time-dependent ROC curves and AUCs for a numeric risk marker against censored survival outcomes at chosen horizons.

skills.name: elastic-net-feature-selection
skills.description: Selects molecular features from bulk expression matrices for binary classification with elastic net logistic regression and alpha and lambda tuning.

skills.name: rf-model-importance-analysis
skills.description: Trains a two-class random forest on a complete numeric feature matrix and reports OOB error curves and ranked variable importance.

skills.name: svm-model-importance-analysis
skills.description: Ranks features for a two-class problem by linear SVM recursive feature elimination with cross-validated error across feature counts.

skills.name: xgboost-analysis
skills.description: Trains an XGBoost binary or regression model on tabular data with one random train-test split and exports performance and feature-importance outputs.

skills.name: lightgbm-analysis
skills.description: Trains a LightGBM model on tabular data with train, validation, and test splits and exports metrics, quality flags, and feature-importance rankings.

skills.name: km-survival-curve
skills.description: Plots Kaplan-Meier curves with log-rank or Wald statistics and a risk table for precomputed risk groups in tabular survival data.

skills.name: reporting-guideline-compliance-checker
skills.description: Reviews manuscripts against reporting guidelines such as TRIPOD, STROBE, CONSORT, and PRISMA and ranks gaps by severity and submission risk.
